note: Counts only ever move DOWN. Raising a number here means accepting worse, and should be a deliberate, explained commit.
reset_reason: Fleet-wide re-baseline 2026-09-10: elegance was blind on any project without a packages/*/src/ monorepo layout (isSrcCode required it unconditionally) and security's dependency-audit ran npm audit unconditionally, silently misreporting in pnpm repos -- both fixed today. This jump is the checker becoming honest, not the code getting worse. The new floor is real, pre-existing debt to work down, not a resting point.
